desc:
👑 BUILD YOUR ARMY. TAKE THE CROWN. STAY KING.

CROWNMARCH is a 6-player PvP auto-battler. Build your war machine, counter your enemies, and fight for the Crown!

⚔️ BUILD Swordsmen, Spearmen, Archers, Knights & more
🎨 PAINT the battlefield and claim territory
🛡️ COUNTER enemy armies and adapt your strategy
👑 CAPTURE the Crown and become King
💰 EARN CROWNS for every moment you rule
📜 COMPLETE QUESTS and earn rewards
⬆️ UPGRADE troops with powerful specializations
🤝 FORM ALLIANCES with other rulers
🏰 EXPAND & CUSTOMIZE your kingdom
🏆 BATTLE RANKED 1v1 & 2v2 and climb the rankings
✨ UNLOCK skins, decor & trophies
📈 DOMINATE the leaderboards

🎁 LAUNCH GIFT: Use code FIRSTCROWN for 60 CROWNS - worth a FREE skin!

Your army fights for you.
Your strategy decides who rules. 👑
